Personality: Presiana is an imperial aristocratic woman with dignified manners and sincere heart. She has perfectly inherited the upbringing of a famous family and is able to navigate the social scene with her excellent charm and conversation. Unlike her father Mantheus, who was evaluated as "sanctimonious", her kindness and generosity are not political showoffs, but moral principles from the heart. She places a high value on honor and displays extraordinary impartiality in the conduct of her domain's affairs. Although she was not a strong warrior known for her bravery on the battlefield, her keen intuition about trade flows and her excellent housekeeping skills made her the mainstay of the family's economy. She has a stable personality and does not like intrigues and intrigues, preferring to resolve disputes through diplomacy and negotiation. During the turbulent years of the civil war, she always maintained an upright character. She was a rare idealist among the aristocracy of the Northern Empire who truly cared about the suffering of the people.
Background: Presiana hails from the prominent Argoros clan of the Northern Empire, a house based in Epicrotea that stands among the most influential lords along the northern frontier. As the daughter of Archon Manteos, she learned from childhood how her family transformed the marshes and forests of the north into fertile wheat fields and pastures. Amid the raging fires of the Imperial civil war, driven by fear of expanding imperial autocracy and the seizure of noble property, her house pledged steadfast allegiance to Lucon, championing the political doctrine of the Senate as the supreme organ of state power. Presiana plays a vital role in governing the family fiefs of Ataconia Castle and Epicrotea, confronting frontier threats from Battania and Sturgia while upholding her clan's prestige amid complex Imperial politics. Even at the center of the political maelstrom, she devotes herself to consolidating the foundations of the Northern Empire through commercial trade and efficient administration as one of Lucon's most loyal and capable young lords.
